claim.summary: The failed criteria were about repository-visible proof of the child sagas' completion, not about the work. I published and committed docs/cleo-t001-completion.md (commit e2cc751): literal `cleo show <id> --full` captures for T001, T002, T024, T035 and T039 showing status done, completedAt timestamps and child rollups (79/79, 18/18, 3/3, 4/4), plus `cleo list --parent <id> --status pending --limit 0` returning matched 0 for each. It explains why the epics carry only the implemented gate (epic completion is by child rollup; ADR-051 §11.1 forbids adding evidence to a completed task) and gives the per-AC evidence mapping with the 103-test/0-fail scoped report and typecheck exit 0. docs/dogfood-6.md now opens with a dated note that its 50/61 and pending-T035/T039 snapshots are historical. C1-C5 remain proven by the same scoped run and provenance.

evidence.C1: test/host/git-install.test.ts with OCGOAL_GIT_INSTALL=1 OCGOAL_GIT_SPEC=github:kryptobaseddev/opencode-goal#v0.8.0: 1 pass, 0 fail (registers /goal, lists the write-goal skill, resolves @opentui/solid). Live goal_provenance: source.target github:kryptobaseddev/opencode-goal#v0.8.0, packageVersion 0.8.0, openCodeVersion 2.0.29, features server/tui/rpc true.
evidence.C2: test/host/goal.test.ts 'a clean reload resumes a running goal by itself' and test/host/paths.test.ts 'the compaction hook records the event and the run continues' both pass in the 103-test report; state persists in .opencode/goals/<slug>/run.json, ledger.jsonl and handoff.json.
evidence.C3: test/host/goal.test.ts 'a false claim gets a HOST VERDICT; the fix completes only after host checks and the verifier pass', test/host/persistent-feedback.test.ts (rejected claim leaves a HOST VERDICT row) and test/host/runtime-provenance.test.ts all pass; src/verify/pipeline.ts and src/server/app.ts implement the verdict path.
evidence.C4: TUI units pass (tui-card 6, tui-dashboard 12, tui-format 2, installed-tui 7, multi-goal-sidebar 3) and test/host/goal.test.ts 'status and pause run without a model turn; resume sends exactly one continuation' passes; goal_provenance reports features.tui true.
evidence.C5: skills/write-goal/SKILL.md ships and is registered (git-install test and goal.test.ts 'the plugin registers write-goal and /goal new attaches it'); test/unit/contract.test.ts 33 tests pass; skills/write-goal/assets/goal.template.yaml parses via src/contract/parse.ts with 0 errors.
evidence.C6: T002 is done, not merely gated. `cleo show T002 --full` at 2026-10-17T05:35Z returns status done, completedAt 2026-10-17T05:35:31.758Z, child rollup 79/79 done, and `cleo list --parent T002 --status pending --limit 0` returns matched 0. Repository text: docs/cleo-t001-completion.md §1 and the 'No pending children' block (commit e2cc751); docs/dogfood-6.md carries a dated top note that its older '50/61' snapshot is historical.
